response.sql: SELECT AVG(g.avg_duration) AS avg_rental_duration, AVG(g.avg_ratio) AS avg_rate_to_cost_ratio FROM (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_duration) AS avg_duration, AVG(CAST(rental_rate AS DOUBLE) / CAST(replacement_cost AS DOUBLE)) AS avg_ratio FROM film WHERE replacement_cost >= 20.99 GROUP BY rating) AS g
